description: Figure 4 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the popularity of ground truth and generated answers in correctly and incorrectly answered samples across three different domains. The horizontal category axis displays three domains ordered from left to right: "Movies", "Songs", and "Basketball". The vertical value axis is labeled "Popularity" and features a linear scale ranging from 20 to 220, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 40. The chart utilizes a dual-legend system to define the grouped bars. Color indicates the language model: blue for "Llama3", red for "Qwen2", and yellow for "ChatGPT". Pattern indicates the accuracy and answer type: solid fill represents "Acc=0 & GT Ans", diagonal hatching represents "Acc=0 & Gene Ans", and vertical stripes represent "Acc=1 & GT Ans". Within each of the three main horizontal categories, the bars are clustered into three model-specific groups (Llama3, Qwen2, ChatGPT), and each model group contains three patterned bars representing the accuracy conditions. Visually, the overall popularity values increase from left to right across the domains. In the "Movies" category, values are the lowest, with the shortest bar in the entire chart being the solid yellow ChatGPT bar at approximately 30. In the "Songs" category, values are moderate, ranging roughly from 60 to 110. In the "Basketball" category, values are the highest, containing the tallest bar in the chart, the diagonally hatched red Qwen2 bar, which reaches approximately 220.
